I did not receive the FISP coupon this year because I am a woman with no schooling, and the village headman usually gives those to men first. With money tight, I cannot buy fertilizer from the shop, so I will spread manure from my goats on this small plot instead. I kept seed from my last harvest, and my daughters and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves because hiring ganyu workers is too expensive for only 0.42 hectares.
